properties.title: Nepal: Monsoon Floods and Landslides - August 2023
properties.description:
**Nepal: 325 displacements, 14–17 August 2023**  
Floods and associated landslides triggered by heavy monsoon rains displaced approximately 325 people in Solukhumbu District, as reported by NDRRMA.  
[NDRRMA - 18 August 2023](https://ndrrma.gov.np/monsoon-update-2023)
